history.title: കാത്തിരിപ്പിനൊടുവിൽ (The Long-Awaited Reunion)
history.summary: After years of emotional long-distance separation, Reenu and her best friend Amal wait anxiously at Kochi CIAL Airport arrivals. When Sachin finally emerges with his luggage trolley, emotions overflow as they lock eyes and reunite.
history.cliffhanger: Just as they embrace, Sachin's warm smile fades slightly as he hints at a mysterious secret regarding his sudden departure from the UK.

history.title: രഹസ്യങ്ങളുടെ നിഴൽ (The Shadow of Secrets)
history.summary: Directly continuing from their emotional airport reunion, Reenu senses Sachin's hesitation. When she questions his sudden, unexpected return from the UK, Sachin tries to brush it off with Amal's witty intervention, but his underlying anxiety is hard to hide. Just as they prepare to leave, a mysterious phone call threatens to shatter the fragile peace.
history.cliffhanger: Sachin's phone abruptly vibrates with an incoming call from an unknown UK number. He frantically declines it and hides the screen, but Reenu catches his panicked expression, her heart sinking with immediate suspicion.
